Cell

Cell is a single display item in the list (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

Cell can be used alone or in combination with CellGroup. CellGroup can provide upper and lower outer borders for Cell.

<maui-cell-group>
  <maui-cell title="cell" value="content" />
  <maui-cell title="cell" value="content" label="description information" border="{{ false }}" />
</maui-cell-group>

2. Card Style

Through the inset property of CellGroup, cells can be converted to rounded card style.

<maui-cell-group inset>
  <maui-cell title="cell" value="content" />
  <maui-cell title="cell" value="content" label="description information" />
</maui-cell-group>

3. Cell Size

The size of the cell can be controlled through the size attribute.

<maui-cell title="cell" value="content" size="large" />
<maui-cell title="cell" value="content" size="large" label="description information" />

4. Display Icon

Display the icon to the left of the title through the icon attribute.

<maui-cell title="cell" icon="location-o" />

5. Group Title

The group title can be specified through the title attribute of CellGroup.

<maui-cell-group title="Group 1">
  <maui-cell title="cell" value="content" />
</maui-cell-group>
<maui-cell-group title="Group 2">
  <maui-cell title="cell" value="content" />
</maui-cell-group>

6. Using Slots

If the above usage does not meet your needs, you can use slots to customize the content.

<maui-cell title="cell">
  <maui-icon name="search" class="custom-icon" />
</maui-cell>

7. Vertically Centered

Through the center attribute, the left and right contents of Cell can be vertically centered.

<maui-cell center title="cell" value="content" label="description information" />

API

CellGroup Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
title Group title String -
inset Whether to display in rounded corner card style Boolean false
border Whether to display outer borders Boolean true

Cell Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
icon Icon name or image link on the left. See Icon for optional values. String -
title Left title String | Number -
title-width Title width, must include units String -
value Right content String | Number -
label Description below the title String -
size Cell size, optional value is large String -
border Whether to display the bottom border Boolean true
center Whether to center content vertically Boolean false
clickable Whether to enable click feedback Boolean false
required Whether to display required form asterisks Boolean false
title-style Title style String -

Cell Event

Event Description Callback Parameter
bind:click Triggered when a cell is clicked -

Cell Slot

Name Description
- Customize the value display content. If the value attribute is set, it will not take effect
